messages.subject: Project Juniper - mutual NDA
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Sandra,

Ahead of sharing rate cards and volumes, I attach a short mutual NDA in our standard form (two-year term, three-year tail on confidentiality). It's deliberately light - happy to take any comments but hopefully we can sign this week.

Best,
James Osei
Senior Associate

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
